notes.title: Deathmatch Soccer has a release date!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm happy to announce that Deathmatch soccer has a release date. Coming to Early Access on the 14th of December!

Get ready to play dirty.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30902793/46dd7bc7820138899c20ef5c8ea27c0d60ee0a2d.gif[/img]
